versions.changelog: Fix Markdown rendering: close code block after Output Format example, move Safety Boundaries sentence into What This Will Not Do, remove Safety Boundaries section
Cleanup patch: remove internal Output Contract, Output Rules, Reference Files sections; replace with user-facing Output Format section; bump version to 2.4.3
Added high-confidence waste-signal checklist requiring downstream-value evidence; updated NO_REPLY rule for recurring tasks returning NO_REPLY without downstream value

v2.4.1: Standardize first-screen output contract. Every result now starts with a fixed Status line. Replace confusing Keep Change / Revert Change / Narrow Change labels with: Investigate One Path, Keep Status Quo, Watch Only, Rollback Candidate, Unsafe to Decide. Add per-status block templates (Fix First / Keep / Watch / Review First / Missing Evidence). NO_REPLY token waste signal added. Recurring task deletion rule added. Read-only safety rule reinforced.

v2.4.0 — simplified positioning as token-waste diagnosis kit; Features moved before Install; new status labels (No Clear Waste, Watch Only, Investigate One Path, Keep Status Quo, Rollback Candidate, Unsafe to Decide); removed Quick Start, Optional Before/After Check, and ops_cat examples; added What You Will Get section; install commands in copy-paste style; activation reduced to three copy-paste commands; read-only safety boundary reinforced.

Reposition from exact billing to token cost signal evaluation. Updated title, activation phrases, status labels, and features. Removed Quick Check Mode, Mixed Sessions, cacheRead section, ops_cat case, and hard rules. Added Optional Before/After Check. Updated What This Will Not Do.

v2.2.1: Remove 'Not Comparable Yet' from Quick Check mode. Add action-oriented statuses only. Add explicit cacheRead explanation. Add ops_cat-style expected output example. Add Hard Rules section: (1) Quick Check must end with concrete action recommendation, not a request for more samples; (2) Do not recommend running new operational work just to manufacture eval data by default; (3) 'Not Comparable Yet' is not a valid Quick Check status. Default mixed sessions to Watch. Keep output short in Quick Check mode.

v2.2.0: Reposition as Quick Check + Eval Kit. New triage-first flow: quick status first, full eval only when comparable evidence exists. Add fallback URL install. New labels: No Action Needed / Watch / Investigate One Path / Run Routing Audit / Unsafe to Judge. Remove evaluation form behavior. Remove before/after sample demands. Removed: Mode 1/2/3 sections, Status Definitions table, Output Format Reference, long checklist language.

v2.1.0: Remove form-first behavior. Add Suspected Change Triage mode. Replace Needs More Samples with Not Comparable Yet for early-stage cases. Add OpenClaw quick-start grouping. Shorten all outputs. Rewrite public SKILL.md structure per user spec.

Repositioned from evaluation form to Evidence Builder. No longer demands a filled before/after template upfront. Now supports three modes: Evidence Builder (no data), Quick Evaluation (partial), Full Evaluation (sufficient data). Removed Required Input, Relationship to Other Skills, What This Will Not Do. Added Start Here, Evidence Status, Evidence Collection Plan, Copy-Paste Evidence Request adapted to user situation. Simplified Safety Boundaries.
Fix: Change 'simple情报任务' to 'simple intelligence tasks' in Risk Class section (English-only website)
Initial release. Evaluate whether a cost-control change should be kept, reverted, narrowed, or tested further.
